name: Drutopia Social
description: Drutopia base feature (aggregator) that pulls in the social_media_links module and core block so a Drutopia site gains a ready-to-place social media links block. Ships no config, no PHP, no schema of its own.
project_description: Drutopia Social is a small base feature of the Drutopia distribution. Its entire substance is its dependency list: it requires core 'block' and the contrib 'social_media_links' module so a Drutopia site gets a ready-to-place social media links block. It ships no PHP, no routes, no services, no permissions and no exported config of its own (only a features.yml marker). Documented from a dev checkout (info.yml carries no 'version:'); the on-disk source is drutopia_social.info.yml, composer.json, drutopia_social.features.yml and README.md. Development is on GitLab and mirrored to drupal.org.
